'''Kawrelak''' was a [[General/Legends|general]] in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Army]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Around [[3643 BBY]] Kawrelak's [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] advisor read the report of [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Vilos]] from [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] regarding possible sighting of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]].<ref name="TOR Jawa Threats">{{TORcite|type=general|New Threats|Tatooine}}</ref>
